description:
Cozy, comfortable, one bedroom apartment on ground floor of detached Victorian home. Quiet, one way street with minimal traffic.

The space
Greenpoint Place still has great dates available but we are booking up fast!
You will enjoy a fully furnished living space which occupies the entire ground floor of our 1889 Victorian home. We offer you a complete kitchen w/ all appliances, beautifully tiled bath w/oversize shower and a separate bedroom w/queen bed, closet and chest of drawers. Living room w/HDTV and a queen size sofa bed for additional sleeping space. Linens, towels, basic paper products and soap/shampoo are included. On street parking is free, safe and widely available most likely in front of our home. We are a short walk to the 7 train which puts you along 42nd St. in one stop! The East River Ferry, a nice alternative to the subway, is only six blocks away on India St. and the East River! Fabulous restaurants, galleries and bars are flooding our neighborhood.
Enjoy the unique, diverse community feeling of Greenpoint. You will feel relaxed and at home after leaving the hustle and bustle of the city. We are as close as you can get to Manhattan without being in it!
Just stay in Greenpoint! You'll be glad you did!

Guest access
The back door in the apartment is an emergency exit only. There is no smoking or congregating out the back door.

Thank you!

Please message me with specific questions regarding the layout of the space. This is a part of our home and we respect the privacy of our guests while sharing our warmth and hospitality!

description:
Enjoy peace and quiet and the comforts of home in a vibrant neighborhood with easy access to Manhattan!

You'll have this sunny, quiet, recently renovated third floor suite all to yourself, with kitchen, living room, two bedrooms, and private bathroom. Hosts live on site and are available to help.

We’re in a lively part of Astoria, with plenty of shops, bars, and restaurants to enjoy. After a short walk to the Ditmars N/W stop, the train is 15-20 minutes to Manhattan.

The space
This is a hosted rental with the host present; we live on the lower two floors and your space is on the third floor. Aside from sharing a front door and entryway, the space is completely private.

With two bedrooms, one with a queen and one with a double bed, the space is perfect for families or for friends traveling together. The larger bedroom can be opened to the living room to let in light, or closed off with doors and curtains for complete privacy. It has a wardrobe for storage and a desk for remote work; the second bedroom is cozy with a large closet.

The kitchen is well equipped for cooking including full-sized refrigerator, four-burner gas stove, and dishwasher, and it's stocked with dishes and essentials. Our FiOS internet is very fast for work or entertainment, and the Roku TV provides all the major streaming services (Netflix, Apple TV, Hulu, HBO Max, Disney+). A bluetooth speaker lets you enjoy your own music, and there's a mini-library of quirky NYC guidebooks, histories, and novels to explore.

We have three sons and we'll gladly provide you with any baby equipment that you need (portable crib, high chair, baby tub, toys and books, etc.).

Guest access
NYC prohibits listing full apartments as short-term rentals. Though this property is listed as a room, it is a full guest suite on the top floor of our townhouse. You will not be sharing the spaces described and pictured with anyone else. Our family lives on the lower floors of the house, but apart from sharing the front door and the entryway, the spaces are separate.

During your stay
We live downstairs and are generally available for any questions about the apartment or the neighborhood. We try to be available for your check-in, but a lockbox is available if that doesn't work out.

Other things to note
Access to the apartment is up two flights of stairs, so it's not a good place for anyone with mobility challenges.

We try to space bookings out by a day or more, so we can almost always accommodate early check-in and/or late check-out; just let us know your schedule!

NYC now restricts short-term stays to no more than two guests in a single property; if you need lodging for more, please get in touch. We may be able to arrange a space nearby for additional people.

The kitchen area is directly over our bedroom, so we do ask that you keep activity there to a minimum late at night. Noise from living room and bedrooms is not an issue.

We do not access phones/internet from sundown Friday to sundown Saturday except for emergencies; if you contact us via Airbnb during that time, we'll respond Saturday night or Sunday morning.

If it's an authentic New York experience you're looking for, you've found it. Located in the heart of the East Village of Manhattan, this one bedroom apartment is as cool as the city and as cozy as the country. Perfect for couples or singles. Not suitable for families. East & west facing windows wash the flat in lots of morning and afternoon light, flat screen tv, internet, queen size tempurpedic bed (with memory foam mattress!), laundry/dry cleaners on ground floor, kitchen, full bath.

The building is heated in winter by steam heat. The pipes can rattle when hot water is flowing thru them. Common in Lower East Side tenements.

Weekends can be noisy. That's what happens when you're surrounded by amazing bars and fantastic restaurants.

description:
Stay in the Heart of NYC. A 15 minute walk to Times Square, you'll be staying in one of the hippest neighborhoods in Manhattan -- Hell's Kitchen!!

** I'm also Fully Vaccinated. I had my Pfizer double-shot. My 2nd dose was April 1st, 2021. I've also been triple-boosted**

The space
@!@ IF YOU'RE COMING FOR THE FIFA World Cup 2026 please scroll down to the bottom of my description for more info @!@

Your Fully Private Room has one comfortable queen size loft bed 🛌 with a Tuft & Needle mattress. It also includes:

* 46” Samsung HD Smart 3D LED TV 📺 (with Netflix, Amazon Prime Video & YouTube Premium)
* Samsung 3D Smart Blu-ray Disc Player (with 3D glasses!)
* WiFi (200 Mbps)
* Mini-Fridge
* Air Conditioning / Heat
* Freshly cleaned sheets, pillows, blankets, bath towels & washcloths
* NYC Guidebooks, Maps and a Native New Yorker's knowledge of cool local 'off-the-beaten-path' stuff to do
* Rotating DISCO 🪩 💃🏽 🕺🏿 BALL & Light!
* 2 Arcade1Up PartyCades with 18 games!!

Most of my visitors are couples, family or good friends who don't mind sharing the bed together. However, I do have a comfortable Intex twin-size air mattress available (BY ADVANCE REQUEST ONLY), but it does make the space in the room a bit tight.

The room is clean, quiet and dark at night. I say this because living in NYC that's often difficult to find with all the street noise, noisy neighbors and bright lights blaring in one's windows. Not the case at my place. You'll sleep 💤 very well.

I have two retro Arcade1Up PartyCades. They’re available for guests to play anytime for free. Some games can even be played together in two-player mode with my additional game controller 🎮 like Joust, Rampage and Street Fighter! 👊

Games included are Defender, Gauntlet, Klax, Rootbeer Tapper, Bubbles, Joust, Rampage, Wizard of War, Sinistar, Gorf, Street Fighter II: The World Warrior, Super Street Fighter II Turbo, Street Fighter II: Champion Edition, Super Puzzle Fighter II: Turbo, Strider, Captain Commando, Eco Fighters and Ghosts ‘n Goblins.

Although I have a fully stocked kitchen I prefer that my guests don’t use it to cook. You’re on vacation after all, visiting NYC, which is a gastronomical and cultural smörgåsbord. You have a mini-fridge in your room.

For a small fee I rent my bicycles 🚴(all 6 of them). Cheaper than renting at any bike shop, you can ride them all day/night too. I also lead easy, safe and fun Night Bicycling Tours of Central Park with Nightrider NYC, as well as other short tours by bike, foot and/or subway. I bicycle toured/camped across the USA twice and rode across Europe in '87, before cell phones and the internet made us all lazy. Let me know what your interests are and maybe I can put something together for you.

I LOVE ❤️ hosting & meeting new people & if I have the time I'll show you around my neighborhood - just ask. I've had some really fun experiences with my former guests.

You'll have some closet space w/hangars & a drawer in my dresser for your clothing, as well as a empty drawer in the WC for your toiletries 🧻 . I have many shampoos, conditioners & other assorted toiletries which you are welcome to use as well as laundry detergent (there's a Laundromat right next to my building).

I'm on the top 5th floor of a 5-story brownstone walk-up **THERE IS NO ELEVATOR**

I provide clean sheets, blankets, pillows & towels and have other assorted toiletries that you can use, including an iron & hairdryer. My place is clean - no bedbugs here!

**I'M A NON-SMOKER 🚭 & DON'T ALLOW SMOKING IN MY APARTMENT OR ANYWHERE ELSE IN THE BUILDING**

My check-in time is flexible, starting at noon, going until whenever you need to arrive. On a case-by-case basis I might be able to allow an earlier check-in time. Check-out is noon, but, again, on a case-by-case basis I might be able to allow a later check-out time.

I'm a big BROADWAY 🎭 buff. I see nearly every show that comes to NY. This could be a Very Expensive 💴 Hobby, but as I'm a New Yorker who comes from a theater background I have connections and can 'sometimes' get tickets MUCH CHEAPER than anywhere else. If you wanna see a show during your visit (and I wholeheartedly recommend you do so), let me know and I'll try and work my magic for you!

I’m also a member of these 3 following ticket sites that I pay a yearly membership fee to in order to get cheap tickets from: Play-by-Play, Clubfreetime and TDF . During your stay I’ll logon to show you the current offerings and get you ticks to something if you want. Also check out the sites BroadwayForBrokePeople and BwayRush to find out about the cheap Rush and Lottery policies for each Broadway 🎭 show.

If you're a museum junkie, visiting all the cultural institutions that NYC has to offer can be rather expensive 💰. Many places have a ‘suggested donation’ admission, but it’s only for New Yorkers. Don’t worry — I’ve got your back. I’ll give you my extra ID and you can use it to get the special deal. When I visit the MET or the Museum of Natural History (among others) I just pay $1 to get in. Check out this for more info: NYCforfree .

I'm not a gym rat, but I do workout at the local gym (Manhattan Plaza Heath Club - MPHC) that's a 10 minute walk from my bldg. If I bring you with me I can get you a $25 day pass. There's a pool, hot tub, full gym and even a rock-climbing center you can use for the day, plus you can take any of the free classes they offer).

As for me, I'll be sleeping in the living room on the Murphy Wall Bed (see my photos for more into)

Got stinky undies? Well, wash 'em then! I have detergent & fabric softener you can use. A cheap & reliable Coin-Operated Laundromat is right next to my building. You can do it yourself or just drop it off to have it washed (usually done the same day/pay by the pound - or kilo for you crazy Europeans.)

Thanks for checking my place out. If you have any questions let me know!

** I'm also Fully Vaccinated 😷 for Covid through Pfizer. I've been triple-boosted **

*** IF AVAILABLE, for an extra $50 per night for a booking of 2 people you can have my Full Private Apartment. If the booking is for 1 person it's an additional $65 per night ***

@!@ njtworldcup
metlifestadium

Unfortunately Airbnb won't allow me to post links here but I can tell you how to get to MetLife Stadium from NYC Penn Station. It's easy. Penn Station is on 8th Avenue and West 34th Street. I live on 10th Avenue between West 46th & 48th Streets.

In short, you'll have to download an App on your phone to purchase your train tickets. They go on sale on May 13th. Ask me any questions you might have about this and I'll explain it in greater detail. @!@

Guest access
NOTHING is off-limits at my flat -- My place is Your Place! You can use my kitchen, just not at 3am! (you know, during Reasonable hours). You're welcome to use and relax in my front room, unless I'm there working or sleeping.

During your stay
During your stay you can be as private as you want, or come and socialize a bit with me. I like to show my guests around my neighborhood and, if they like, go out for a drink or two. I'm also an avid cyclist, and could possibly take you on a tour of Central Park (I have 6 bikes in the basement we can use). I'll be sleeping in the front room most nights and in-and-out during the day. If you want some ideas & suggestions on off-the-beaten-track stuff that us NYC locals do, just ask!!

Other things to note
Although Hell's Kitchen has a pretty sordid history, it's now one of the hippest neighborhoods in Madhattan! Full of great bars and diverse restaurants that stay open late, just a 15 minute walk to the Theatre District and Times Square, it's a safe, centrally located area where you'll find a lot to do and see for the entire family.

A bit about me:

I'm a Handyman/Writer/Actor/Bicycle Tour Guide and Amateur USBC Bowler trying to survive in the Concrete Jungle we call the Big Apple. I've been surviving here since 1984, so I must be doing something right!

You will be sharing the upper three floors (unit 2) with myself and my family and our private event space, so be aware that there will be occasionally lots of activity in the home as we go about our lives as artists, poets and theater artists.

The space

Plenty of restaurants, beer gardens, lounges, cafes and yoga studios to keep you busy. If you are here to spend most of your days in Manhattan then Ditmars Blvd. - Astoria Queens is the way to go.
Cc
It is the first stop of the N or W line, you will always have a seat on the train at this station and the best part is that because it is the first stop there are always 2 trains at the station so no need to stand on the platform in the heat, rain, cold or snow while waiting for the train.

The other advantage to being at Ditmars is that the trains run Express during rush hour so you bypass all the other people waiting at the other stations. The train ride is 12 minutes to 59th Street & Lexington Ave - Midtown. Front garden wall gives privacy from sidewalk.

You can either have the laundromat pick up and deliver to you or you can walk it over or you can also do your own wash if you prefer.
Most people who stay here use the drop off service on their way to work in the morning and pick it up on the way home in the evening because they are too busy making the most of their time in NYC.

Great for someone who wants to get a feel for what it is like to live in NY in a real apartment not a hotel room.

Ideal for someone who needs a place totally hooked up for a short time while they visit NY, take a class, or need a transitional place while they look for work or a long term rental.

The space
This is a beautifully renovated, one-bedroom apartment in an outstanding location. It is quiet, safe and sunny and steps from Riverside Park, on the Hudson River, which has some of the best biking, dog walking and running trails, as well as beautiful manicured and forested gardens in NY.

This is an ELEVATOR building, high-speed wi-fi, Smart TVs in both the living and bedrooms including Sling TV for live tv. It’s also equipped with chargers, umbrellas, wireless printer and much more to make this your home away from home OR remote work space - with separate designated office area.

The bedroom is equipped with a fabulous Bear mattress King Bed, super soft linens & extra pillows. The living and bedroom have soundproof windows and bedroom has blackout curtains.

The well-organized & cozy galley kitchen has all upgraded appliances and is fully equipped with Nespresso machine, coffee maker, dishwasher, microwave, large fridge & more. There is a dining table for 4 and is fully outfitted for cooking.

The beautiful windowed marble-tiled bathroom has a bath/shower combination with amazing water pressure. All toiletries (see list below for details) are provided, and of course lots of towels.

The apartment is located 5 blocks from Central Park and just a 5-minute walk to an express subway station (2 stops from Times Square), minutes from Columbus Circle, Columbia University, Lincoln Center, Natural History Museum and a couple subway stops to Greenwich Village. And just across Central Park (walkable) you'll arrive at the Metropolitan Museum of Art.

There are many great markets & restaurants within a 5-block radius plus all the conveniences that NYC has to offer, in an incredibly safe neighborhood.

description:
Trendy, real 2 Bedroom home just steps from world-class shopping, dining, entertainment, and transportation.

The space
Charming 2BR apartment on the trendy Lower East Side (Ludlow and Rivington)

Two Real Bedrooms each with a closet and window.

1st Bedroom has a regular full-size bed (sleeps 2)
2nd bedroom has a Queen-sized bed (sleeps 2)

The living room has a couch that fits four people and there is a small, 4 person dining area.

Living Room has a flat-screen TV Wifi, internet ready TV (Roku) (no cable).

Full Kitchen with everything you need to cook

**The apartment is 2 flights up in a walk-up (non-elevator) building**

The Lower East Side is one of NYC's most hip and centrally located neighborhoods. Just steps from restaurants, galleries, bars, lounges, coffee shops, whole foods, shopping, and everything else you can think of.

Just 1 block from the F, J, M, Z trains

The space is perfect for a couple or two friends.

This is a lived-in home so some closets, cabinets, etc. are in use. There is hanging and storage space available in each bedroom.

**Sorry no pets and no parties or gatherings of any type.

We are happy to provide suggestions on neighborhood and city attractions, restaurants, etc. Just ask.

Alternate dates may be available

Guest access
The entire space.

listing_name: Room in a New York loft
description:
Looking for a tenant starting early August. Professionals and longer stays are welcome.
The room is fully furnished. Linens provided. Kitchen fully equipped.
All subway lines available from the Fulton street subway (A/C/2/3/4/5/6/J) Uniquely convenient as it is the only station in Mahnattan with such a number of lines!
Spacious bedroom which offers a close-up view of the Brooklyn Bridge.
This is part of a 4BR loft located in the South street seaport.

The space
A queen size bed and a desk to work. A small coffee table and a lounging chair. View of the Brooklyn bridge from your window is what summarize this room in a nutshell.
The feeling of staying in a true home is what best describes this entire place.
The bedroom is your private space and you have shared use of the common area, living room, dining, kitchen and bathroom.
The room features a very big closet where you can store all your clothes and still have room to store your luggage.
This is part of a 4BR loft located in the South street seaport. Friendly atmosphere for nice people.

Guest access
All common area. Kitchen, living room, bathroom, etc. Guests have access to everything in living room and kitchen area (fully stacked kitchen). Juicer, kettle, blender, Nespresso coffee maker etc.
Guests are expected to clean after themselves. Understandably keeping the kitchen, bathroom and other shared spaces as they found them helps create a stress-free environment as well as keeping things clean for everyone.

Other things to note
Location: The Seaport neighborhood is like a small and very charming village next to FIDI but it is its own thing entirely.

Train/Transports: Subway Fulton street and Brooklyn bridge. A-C-2-3-5-6-4 lines and the M15 express and local bus stop. Multiple Citibikes around, amazing bars and restaurants in the all over the area.

Loft will be shared with 3 other people (mixed genders) who are friendly, clean, respectful and easy going as you should be as well.
Please note that this is a walk up building and the apartment is located on the 5th floor.

description:
EXCELLENT FOR TOURISTS, and visitors to New York City.
Directly across from the subway station - Q train.
Spacious, cozy, clean and quiet Ditmas Park apartment. Train - within 30 minutes ride on subway to midtown Manhattan (34th St., Herald Square, Manhattan).
Easy access to busses.

SAFE BUILDING
SAFE NEIGHBORHOOD

The space
Clean and private accommodations in spacious, pleasant environment.

INCLUDED:
Free Hi-Speed Wireless Internet
Mini Refrigerator (in bedroom)
Microwave oven (in bedroom)
Work desk (in bedroom)
Bathtub/shower combo ( VERY IMPORTANT - SHARED SPACE - CLYGO - Clean as you go)

Utensils are provided along with LIMITED USE OF KITCHEN TO CLEAN UTENSILS. The kitchen is kept clean and must be left in the condition you found it. We have a 100% bug-free environment and want to always keep it that way.


Fresh bed linens & bath towels provided.

Guest access
Safe elevated doorman building in great mixed residential neighborhood. This is an older building WITH A SLOW ELEVATOR that works well - we are on the third floor, therefore walking up is an option if you don't like elevators. If you do not like older buildings, do NOT book with me. What I am providing to you is a space within my apartment - I do not have control over the outer environs.

We are 1 block away from diverse neighborhood restaurants and the Key Food supermarket, as well as a food-coop for organic and holistic offerings.

Q and B trains are 2 minutes away

N.B. LAUNDROMAT IS LOCATED 1 BLOCK AWAY (washer/dryer NOT available in apartment)

Close proximity to the Brooklyn public library, the Brooklyn Botanical Gardens, and downtown Brooklyn - a mere ten to fifteen minutes away by train or bus.


PROSPECT PARK - if you like the park, historic Prospect Park is only 10-15 minutes walk away.

Driving into Manhattan can take as little as 15 minutes - longer if there is traffic, but who drives into Manhattan? 😊

PARKING: We have alternate parking rules in our neighborhood on Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays and Fridays from 11.30am to 1pm. There is free parking in the streets, and parking can get challenging late at nights, however with planning this is not problematic.

During your stay
I will be available to answer any questions you have, in person, or by text and/or telephone, at all times. Always remember - there are no foolish questions. I cannot read your mind, so you must let me know if you need my help with anything. I will always do my best to accommodate you.

Other things to note
The apartment is quiet, clean and pleasant.
The building abuts a side street which is fairly busy. Therefore when the windows are open, we hear the traffic and voices from passersby and passing motor vehicles - this is Brooklyn - however, it is not disruptive.

I am ALWAYS available to answer your questions and promise to do whatever I can to make your stay a pleasant and hassle free one. In the unlikely event an issue should arise (ANY ISSUE), you MUST let me know ASAP, as I will never be able to read your mind. And I will endeavor to resolve that issue expediently.

Please, DO NOT attempt to manipulate, correct, change, reprogram or otherwise fix any electronic device, without my prior consent.
